name: Entertainer
description: Individuals who are involved with the media, whether as reporters, artists or celebrities.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: You are a witer, holographer or other creative.

journalist.name: Journalist
journalist.description: You report on local or galactic events for a news feed, the TAS or other organisation.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: You are an actor, dancer, acrobat, professional athlete or other public performer.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury Table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury Table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You expose or are involved in a scandal of some sort.
mishaps.3: Public opinion turns on you. Reduce your SOC by 1.
mishaps.4: You are betrayed by a peer. One of your Contacts or Allies betrays you, ending your career. That Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy. If you have no Contacts or Allies, then you are betrayed by someone you never saw coming and still gain a Rival or Enemy.
mishaps.5: An investigation, tour, project or expedition goes wrong, stranding you far from home. Gain one of Survival 1, Pilot 1, Persuade 1 or Streetwise 1.
mishaps.6: You are forced out because of censorship or controversy. What truth did you get too close to? You gain DM+2 to the qualification roll for your next career.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap Table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are invited to take part in a controversial event or exhibition. Roll Art or Investigate 8+. If you succeed, gain one SOC. If you fail, lose one SOC.
events.4: You are a part of your homeworld's celebrity circles. Gain one of Carouse 1, Persuade 1, Steward 1 or a Contact.
events.5: One of your works is especially well received and popular, making you a minor celebrity. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
events.6: You gain a patron in the arts. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll and an Ally.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events Table.
events.8: You have the opportunity to criticise or even bring down a questionable political leader on your homeworld. If you refuse and support the leader, you gain nothing. If you accept, gain an Enemy and roll Art or Persuade 8+. If you succeed, gain one level in any skill you already have. If you fail, increase a skill anyway and roll on the Mishaps table.
events.9: You go on a tour of the secotr, visiting several worlds. Gain D3 Contacts.
events.10: One of your pieces of art is stolen and the investigation brings you into the criminal underworld. Gain one of Streetwise 1, Investigate 1, Recon 1 or Stealth 1.
events.11: As an artist, you lead a strange and charmed life. Go to the Life Events Table and have an Unusual Event.
events.12: You win a prestigious prize. You are automatically promoted.
